name: t3code
one_liner: A phone and desktop app that lets you check on and control your AI coding agents running on your computer from anywhere.
buyer: A developer who kicks off long AI coding tasks and wants to check progress and approve steps from their phone.
business_use_cases: A solo founder starts a long AI build before leaving the office and approves/steers it from their phone at a coffee shop.
A tech lead supervises multiple AI agents running on different machines from one mobile dashboard.
A remote team standardizes on it to coordinate who's running which agent, avoiding collisions.

money_ideas.idea: No direct product here — it's a free, open tool the team explicitly says isn't being sold.

steal_this: This weekend, if you run an AI coding bootcamp or newsletter, write a short guide on using it for 'AI coding on the go' to build audience goodwill.
